author: Zephyr I
title: Grouped 2-head attention with learned per-head temperatures (LN-gated ConvLSTM 64ch)
abstract: Extend grouped 2-head attention by learning per-head temperatures to avoid credit dilution (head-specific sharpness). Keep LN-gated ConvLSTM (64ch), default PG, budget, and BASE_SEED=42.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/zephyr')
from networks.cnn_convlstm_ln_mha_grouped_learned import CNNConvLSTMLN_Grouped2H_LearnedTemp
from ray import tune

BASE_SEED = 42

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        'conv_lstm_features': tune.choice([64]),
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    return CNNConvLSTMLN_Grouped2H_LearnedTemp(
        cnn_features_1=hparams['cnn_features_1'],
        cnn_features_2=hparams['cnn_features_2'],
        conv_lstm_features=hparams['conv_lstm_features'],
        init_temp=1.0,
    )
